safety_verdicts.content: Patient has a 4-day history of dry, itchy skin, located mainly on the chest and back.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts mention chest involvement but do not document the rash/skin changes being mainly on the back as stated in the Gold fact.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting that the rash/itch also involves the back slightly reduces accuracy of the distribution, which can influence differential diagnosis and assessment of severity/extent. However, it is unlikely by itself to change urgent management in an otherwise stable pruritic dermatitis presentation.

Medication/dosing documentation errors carry meaningful patient safety risk.
